metadata.title: Anthropic IPO: How to Buy the Stock Before It Hits the Open Market<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text: Anthropic plans to give individual investors a chance to buy shares of the company when it goes public as early as this month. The artificial intelligence company anticipates allocating a portion of IPO shares to brokerage customers of Charles Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood Financial (including its TradePMR unit), SoFi, and Morgan Stanley’s E*Trade, according to a Nov. 2 regulatory filing.
